cases.input: Triage a bounded set of already loaded inbox threads containing a real deadline, a routine reply request, a confirmed delegation, a waiting-on-reply thread, and an FYI message. Derive explicit next actions without mutating the mailbox.
requiredBehaviors: classify each thread from concrete message facts into one primary triage class
derive a small explicit next action and keep it pending until external execution is confirmed
preserve thread provenance while minimizing persisted message content
forbiddenBehaviors: treat sender hierarchy or tone alone as urgency
skillAnchors: Eine Klasse ist eine **Triage-Empfehlung**, kein Mailbox-Status

cases.input: A senior sender writes in an urgent tone, but there is no explicit deadline and the previous thread context is missing. Do not overstate urgency or invent the missing context.
requiredBehaviors: avoid urgent classification based only on tone or hierarchy
use needs-context or reduced confidence until the missing evidence is available
skillAnchors: Tonfall, Großschreibung oder Absenderhierarchie allein machen eine Nachricht nicht dringend

cases.input: A draft triage marks a message urgent because the sender is senior, says an unverified delegation is complete, and claims FYI messages were archived although no mailbox action occurred.
requiredBehaviors: reject unverified delegated or completed status
restore mailbox mutations to pending suggestions unless externally verified
forbiddenBehaviors: present planned archive or reply actions as completed
skillAnchors: keine Mailbox-Mutation wird als erfolgt dargestellt
